import bpy, json
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0,0,0.5))
smoke = bpy.context.object
smoke.name = "phw_mcp_smoke_cube"
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
smoke.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = smoke
bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=True, scale=True)
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath='/Users/john.capobianco/NAF_AC6/WORKSHOP/lab/examples/PerHopWorks/assets/models/_smoke.glb', export_format='GLB', use_selection=True, export_yup=True)
bpy.data.objects.remove(smoke, do_unlink=True)
print("PHW_SMOKE_EXPORTED")
